title: 〜も〜ば〜も / 〜も〜なら〜も
romaji: mo … ba … mo / mo … nara … mo
meaning: both … and …; not only … but also
simpleExplanation: 〜も〜ば〜も lists two items that share the same tendency: 彼はお酒も飲めば、たばこも吸う (he both drinks and smokes). The first item takes も and the ば-form; the second takes も. Both items point in the same direction, good or bad. With な-adjectives and nouns, なら replaces ば.
whenUsed: Both speech and writing; slightly more written than 〜も〜し〜も. Common in character descriptions and evaluations. In casual talk, 〜も〜し、〜も is more usual.
formation: Noun も + Verb ば + Noun も + Verb
Noun も + い-adjective ければ + Noun も + adjective
Noun も + な-adjective なら + Noun も
Noun も + Noun なら + Noun も (先生も先生なら、生徒も生徒だ = both are as bad as each other)

examples.ja: 彼はお酒も飲めば、たばこも吸う。
examples.reading: かれはおさけものめば、たばこもすう。
examples.note: Two bad habits of the same tendency.

examples.ja: この店は値段も安ければ、味もいい。
examples.reading: このみせはねだんもやすければ、あじもいい。
examples.en: At this restaurant the prices are cheap and the food is good too.
examples.note: Two good qualities: cheap and tasty.

examples.ja: 彼女は歌も上手なら、ダンスも上手だ。
examples.reading: かのじょはうたもじょうずなら、ダンスもじょうずだ。
examples.en: She is good at singing and good at dancing too.
examples.note: な-adjective with なら: good at both.

examples.ja: この地域は夏は暑ければ、冬は寒い。
examples.reading: このちいきはなつはあつければ、ふゆはさむい。
examples.en: In this region, summers are hot and winters are cold.
examples.note: Two harsh conditions listed with い-adjectives.

examples.reading: おやもおやなら、こもこだ。
examples.en: Like parent, like child (both are at fault).
examples.note: Noun も Noun なら: a set idiom of mutual blame.

similarGrammar.difference: Casual equivalent: お酒も飲むし、たばこも吸う.
"Not only": the second item is the focus; も〜ば〜も treats them equally.
Unordered list with a feeling of being overwhelmed.

commonMistakes.wrong: この店は値段も安ければ、味は悪い。
commonMistakes.right: この店は値段も安ければ、味もいい。
commonMistakes.why: Both items must share the same tendency; a contrast is expressed with が / けど.

commonMistakes.wrong: 彼女は歌も上手ければ、ダンスも上手だ。
commonMistakes.right: 彼女は歌も上手なら、ダンスも上手だ。
commonMistakes.why: な-adjectives use なら, not ければ.

commonMistakes.wrong: お酒が飲めば、たばこも吸う。
commonMistakes.right: お酒も飲めば、たばこも吸う。

usageNotes: Common in evaluations: 値段も安ければ量も多い.
Noun も Noun なら Noun も Noun だ is an idiom of mutual criticism.
The ば-clause is not a condition here; it just links parallel items.
jlptTips: Look for も on both items around the blank; the first predicate is in ば / なら form.
Check the tendency: two positives or two negatives, never mixed.
Distractors include ば〜ほど (proportional) and し (casual); if the text is written style, も〜ば〜も is likely.
